name: pypi/mcp-server-sqlite
title: SQLite
description: Work with SQLite: inspect table structure, read data, and modify records with SQL queries.

toolsSummary.name: read_query
toolsSummary.description: Run read-only SQL (SELECT) against the opened database.

toolsSummary.name: write_query
toolsSummary.description: Run SQL that mutates data (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) when not restricted by deployment.

toolsSummary.name: list_tables / describe-table
toolsSummary.description: List tables and view column types for a chosen table (per upstream README).

io.sami/gallery.about: MCP server for a local SQLite file: run SQL, explore schema, and let agents work with structured data without leaving the stdio tool host.
